title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: pull files into an investigation from audit log activity
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft documents the audit search workflow, required permissions, search limits and storage and compute billing. The DSI permissions article supports the administrator path, although the general portal permissions article uses a different navigation label; that documentation disagreement should be noted.
